_comment: Route gw telemetry to your own backend via a local OpenTelemetry Collector
_description: Overrides the maintainer's built-in endpoint so gw sends to a local Collector instead. The Dash0 token lives in the Collector config (see otel-collector.dash0.yaml), never in this committed file. NOTE: 'enabled' here has no effect — opt-in is per-machine: run 'gw telemetry on' or set GW_TELEMETRY=1.
_usage: 1) Commit this (or merge fields into your config.json). 2) Run a Collector on http://localhost:4318. 3) Each user who wants to send telemetry runs 'gw telemetry on' on their own machine.
